title: Colonial Viper Mk VII (Battlestar Galactica, 2004)
intro: The Viper Mk VII is the newer version of the fictional Colonial fighter in Battlestar Galactica (2004). It has the same stick and throttle as the Mk II, but a computerised panel with screens and a networked flight computer. In the miniseries a Cylon computer virus shuts these fighters down.

panels.name: Canopy
panels.text: The canopy over the Viper Mk VII pilot's seat.
panels.context: It gives a good view for dogfights against Cylon fighters.

controls.name: Canopy
controls.text: A clear canopy over the single seat of the Viper Mk VII.
controls.context: The pilot looks out through it to find enemy fighters.

areas.name: Digital instrument panel
areas.text: Computerised displays instead of the old dials.

panels.name: Digital instrument panel
panels.text: Screens instead of the old round dials, and the networked flight computer.
panels.context: The newer panel shows more information, but its computer link is a weakness in the series.

controls.name: Flight displays
controls.text: Screens show the flight information that the old Viper shows on round dials.
controls.context: The pilot reads speed, fuel and engine state from them.

controls.name: Networked flight computer
controls.text: A flight computer that is linked to the other ships' computers.
controls.context: In the miniseries a Cylon virus uses this link to shut the fighters down, which the old Mk II escapes.
